item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-55952d015b2d7b91","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 25 July 2023, President el-Sisi reviewed the relocation of more than 100 government agencies, including 30 ministries, with approximately 40,000 employees and workers, to the New Administrative Capital.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Egyptian Presidency attributes the meeting and directives to President el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source is an official presidential account and does not independently verify the figures or implementation quality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-55952d015b2d7b91","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The New Administrative Capital Company was presented as generating state revenue, paying taxes to the treasury, developing infrastructure, and attracting local and foreign private investment without burdening the state budget.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported in July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency reports the financial and developmental claims made during el-Sisi's review meeting.","limitations":["The source provides no audited revenue, tax, budget, or investment results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-55952d015b2d7b91","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi directed officials to maintain high standards of quality, safety, and technology in New Administrative Capital projects and to continuously monitor traffic as activity increased.","question_ids":["3B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directive issued in July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The official account attributes the directives to President el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not document compliance, enforcement, or measured safety outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-55952d015b2d7b91","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"A presidential initiative allocated scholarships for outstanding students from Upper Egypt at international universities in the New Administrative Capital.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The initiative was described in a July 2023 presidential meeting report.","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency attributes sponsorship of the scholarship initiative to President el-Sisi.","limitations":["The number of scholarships, eligibility process, funding, and actual uptake are not specified."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0dde2482010ca8f6","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In his 3 May 2023 opening speech for the National Dialogue, el-Sisi stated that the dialogue should be comprehensive, include all viewpoints, produce concrete and studied results, and operate through democratic political practice.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.10","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct statement from May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The speech is attributed to President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.","limitations":["This is a stated program and does not establish that participation was fully inclusive or that outcomes were implemented."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0dde2482010ca8f6","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi said he had closely followed preparations for the National Dialogue, supported it continuously, would facilitate its success, activate its outputs, and participate in its final stages.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.3","8B.2","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statement made in May 2023 concerning an ongoing 2023 process.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments are stated by President el-Sisi.","limitations":["The speech does not document subsequent implementation, correction, or independent monitoring."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2f0b61c26992f2cc","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"In November 2023, approximately 12 children with cancer or blood disorders, accompanied by family members, were evacuated from Gaza through the Rafah crossing to Egypt and Jordan for continued treatment, with Egyptian officials participating in coordination.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly documented on 10 November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"WHO reports coordination with Egyptian officials but does not attribute the evacuation personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not specify which Egyptian institutions or decisions enabled the evacuation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0f9cdef5df80ccb","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"On 21 October 2023, Egypt's Rafah crossing opened for a first convoy carrying three trucks and 60 metric tons of WFP food supplied by the Egyptian Red Crescent and the United Nations for Palestinians in Gaza.","question_ids":["2B.7","3B.9","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly documented in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"WFP reports the opening and Egyptian Red Crescent role but does not attribute the operational decision personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not establish the President's personal involvement or the duration and consistency of access."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0f9cdef5df80ccb","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"WFP reported that 930 metric tons of emergency food were positioned at or near Rafah awaiting renewed access, while approximately 520,000 people had received WFP food assistance and the operation was being expanded to support 1.1 million people in Gaza.","question_ids":["3B.9","6B.2","6B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reported on 21 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are WFP operational figures; they are not attributed personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The figures measure WFP operations and do not by themselves establish Egyptian policy effectiveness or presidential control."]},{"source_id":"SRC-11778e49a3e4ac8f","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The World Bank forecast MENA growth to fall to 1.9% in 2023 from 6% in 2022, citing oil-production cuts, subdued oil prices, tight global financial conditions, and high inflation; it projected oil-importing economies at 3.6% growth versus 4.9% in 2022.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.9","5B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Forecast published in October 2023 for the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns regional conditions and does not attribute the outcome specifically to el-Sisi.","limitations":["It is not an Egypt-specific outcome and identifies substantial external causes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-11778e49a3e4ac8f","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The World Bank reported that macroeconomic shocks from 2020–2022 may have pushed an additional 5.1 million people out of work in MENA, and recommended flexible real wages combined with well-targeted cash transfers to reduce long-term household costs.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The analysis was published in 2023 and assessed preceding shocks affecting the 2023 context.","ruler_attribution":"The finding is regional and does not establish a policy decision by el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not provide Egypt-specific employment attribution or assess Egyptian government response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8bf0a1921c9d26a5","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The World Bank approved a FY2023–2027 Country Partnership Framework aligned with Egypt Vision 2030 and the National Climate Change Strategy 2050, targeting private-sector jobs, human capital, resilience to shocks, regional integration, governance and citizen engagement, and women's empowerment.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Framework approved in March 2023 for FY2023–2027.","ruler_attribution":"The framework is aligned with Egyptian government and presidential objectives, but the source does not attribute its design personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["This is a partnership strategy and does not demonstrate executed Egyptian results during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8bf0a1921c9d26a5","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Egypt Country Partnership Framework was supported by a planned US$7 billion lending envelope over FY2023–2027, with the Ministry of International Cooperation as the main governmental counterpart for planning, coordination, and follow-up.","question_ids":["5B.6","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Approved in March 2023 for the 2023–2027 period.","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies the Egyptian ministry as counterpart but does not attribute the arrangement personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["Planned financing is not evidence of disbursement or completed outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fc193a01c1ea2a75","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"WFP's Egypt Country Strategic Plan for 2023–2028 states that inflation, commodity-price increases, currency devaluations, poverty, malnutrition, gender inequality, unemployment, climate shocks, water scarcity, and environmental degradation threatened food and nutrition security, disproportionately affecting vulnerable people.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Plan approved in June 2023 and covering 2023–2028.","ruler_attribution":"The assessment concerns Egypt's conditions and does not attribute the problems personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source describes risks and conditions rather than a completed 2023 policy outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fc193a01c1ea2a75","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"WFP planned to work within the presidential Haya Karima initiative, which it described as reaching 5,000 villages through an integrated local approach, to improve livelihoods, resilience, social and economic inclusion, nutrition, and shock-responsive social protection.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The strategic plan was approved in 2023 and covers 2023–2028.","ruler_attribution":"WFP identifies Haya Karima as a presidential development initiative, but does not attribute implementation results personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The plan states intended coverage and activities, not verified 2023 completion or distributional outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a852bee6357f1b10","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Egyptian Charter for Responsible AI is recorded as an active, non-binding guidance document beginning in 2023, intended to promote safe and fair AI use, ethical safeguards, rights protection, and trust across public governance, innovation, health, education, and the digital economy.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The OECD record gives a 2023 start year, although the page was added in 2025.","ruler_attribution":"The initiative is assigned to Egypt's National Council for AI; the source does not attribute it personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["It is non-binding guidance, and the supplied record does not show funding, enforcement, inspection, or implementation outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4997e8193f14abe1","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In March 2023, the UN Human Rights Committee reported that it had held a constructive dialogue with Egypt's delegation, while identifying concerns and making recommendations concerning Egypt's periodic report.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","7B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly reported on 24 March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Egypt's state delegation and does not identify el-Sisi's personal response.","limitations":["The supplied meeting summary does not state the specific concerns or recommendations regarding Egypt."]},{"source_id":"SRC-60bf97ac1257c341","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International reported that Egyptian authorities had, since 1 October 2023, arrested and interrogated at least 196 people over unauthorized protests, alleged terrorism-related activity, or alleged publication of false news, and that genuine opposition candidates were prevented from running in the forthcoming presidential election.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reported on 23 November 2023 concerning events before the December 2023 election.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the conduct to Egyptian authorities under el-Sisi's presidency; it does not document a personal order by el-Sisi.","limitations":["Amnesty's characterization is an external human-rights assessment, and the source does not establish the President's direct involvement in each arrest."]},{"source_id":"SRC-60bf97ac1257c341","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that presidential hopeful Ahmed al-Tantawy, his campaign manager, and 21 supporters were prosecuted over alleged unauthorized distribution of election-related documents; 21 supporters remained in pretrial detention, and campaign supporters reportedly faced intimidation and obstacles at notary offices.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Criminal proceedings began on 7 November 2023 and were reported on 23 November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The proceedings are attributed to Egyptian authorities; no personal presidential order is shown.","limitations":["The source reports Amnesty's account and includes the National Elections Authority's rejection of the candidate's institutional-obstacle claims."]},{"source_id":"SRC-60bf97ac1257c341","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Citizen Lab reportedly assessed with high confidence that al-Tantawy's phone was targeted with Predator spyware and that the government was involved.","question_ids":["4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The targeting was reported as occurring in September 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports Citizen Lab's attribution of likely government involvement, not a personal order by el-Sisi.","limitations":["The supplied source does not identify the specific government agency or establish presidential knowledge."]},{"source_id":"SRC-60bf97ac1257c341","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported arbitrary arrests of dozens of people, including children, during pro-Palestinian protests between 20 and 29 October 2023, including arrests near Tahrir Square and after demonstrations at Al-Azhar Mosque; at least 56 protesters remained in pretrial detention and at least six others were forcibly disappeared.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Events occurred in October 2023 and were reported on 23 November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the arrests and alleged abuses to Egyptian security forces under el-Sisi's government.","limitations":["The source is an Amnesty report and does not establish a personal presidential directive for each operation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-60bf97ac1257c341","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that security forces dispersed a peaceful teachers' protest on 15 October 2023; 14 teachers were detained pending investigation on terrorism, false-news, and social-media-related allegations after protesting civil-service appointment requirements.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.5","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The conduct is attributed to Egyptian authorities under el-Sisi's presidency.","limitations":["The source reports allegations and does not document a personal presidential order."]},{"source_id":"SRC-60bf97ac1257c341","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that on 23 October 2023 the army used live ammunition to disperse peaceful protesters in Rafah who demanded permission to return to North Sinai communities from which they had been forcibly displaced since 2014; at least 47 people were reportedly placed in pretrial detention.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Incident occurred on 23 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the use of force to the Egyptian army under el-Sisi's government.","limitations":["The source relies on Sinai for Human Rights and does not establish a personal presidential command or provide an independent casualty assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f10849ba5fe5f95e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The National Investment Bank page is a general index listing Egyptian laws and regulations on companies, government accounting, contracting, investment, public budgeting, civil service, insurance, labor, taxation, and related subjects; it contains no specific 2023 event, implementation result, or institutional finding concerning el-Sisi.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The page has no clear 2023-specific material fact.","ruler_attribution":"No ruler-specific attribution is provided.","limitations":["The document is a general legal index rather than evidence of 2023 enforcement or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9aaf0e435a379214","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The Arms Control Association reported that Russia revoked its ratification of the CTBT in November 2023 while stating it would continue cooperating with CTBTO monitoring and observing a test moratorium.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly concerns 2023 but not Egypt or el-Sisi.","ruler_attribution":"The fact concerns Russian authorities, not el-Sisi.","limitations":["No material fact about Abdel Fattah el-Sisi or Egypt is present."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus contains many official plans, statements, and external assessments but limited independently verified evidence of implementation, budget execution, correction, or end-of-period outcomes.","Several Gaza-related and regional economic facts involve Egyptian institutions or external conditions without establishing personal decision-making by el-Sisi."]}
